insights.content: DTC #1 is 3-1 in 35B after a closer-than-expected 3-2 win over DTC #3. Kiyono/Jarvis were deployed at D3 and lost to Chang/Addison — a lineup call that needs revisiting. Corelle (S1) beat Tayoni Coleman 6-3 6-0, the D1 pair (Allen/Waters and Paull/Perdomo) both won, but DTC #3 took S2 and D3. DTC #1 leads 35B tied with Dragonridge at 3-1.

Dragonridge CC swept Spanish Trail #1 5-0 and is now tied with DTC #1 at 3-1. TPC beat Desert Palm 3-2 and is 3-2. Red Rock #2 (unknown W5 result) has been dominant all season. DTC #3 is 1-3, Spanish Trail #1 is 1-4 and fading. W6 — DTC #1 vs Dragonridge — now decides 35B leadership.

Summerlin swept Anthem CC 5-0 in 35A (same team that swept TPC 5-0 in 3.0). They are now 4-1, tied with DTC #2 (4-1 over Spanish Trail #2). LTF beat Red Rock #1 4-1 — Yan Uyeno (3.55→3.83) is still Red Rock's only bright spot. 35A is essentially a Summerlin-DTC#2 race.

Kelly Nguyen (DTC #3, 3.34→3.05, 0-4 in 35), Joann Komanowski (LTF, 3.54→3.29, struggling), Lisa Gobel (Spanish Trail #2, 3.54→3.28). Tayoni Coleman (3.11 baseline) is 1-2 in 3.5 — her 3.0 dominance (4-0 vs avg 2.93 opponents) hasn't translated upward.

Biggest 35B threats: Dragonridge's Melanie Isbell (3-0+ at S1/S2) leads a team that just swept 5-0. Arika Carrier (TPC, 3.60→3.74, D1 force). Red Rock #2's Mary Lind (3.64, undefeated). 35A: Summerlin's Rika Cook (3.54→3.81) and Yan Uyeno (Red Rock, 3.55→3.83).

sections.title: 04/25 — next match preview: DTC #1 vs DRAGONRIDGE CC

insights.content: DTC #1 (3-1) vs Dragonridge (3-1) — this is the 35B title match. Winner controls the top spot. Dragonridge just swept Spanish Trail #1 5-0 and is playing their best tennis.
Melanie Isbell is Dragonridge's singles engine — 3-0+ at S1/S2. Corelle (S1) will be tested hard. This is DTC #1's most dangerous line.
DTC #1's Kiyono + Hernandez should be favored at D1 against Dragonridge's D1 pair. Don't misplace Kiyono at D3 again — that was a costly lineup error against DTC #3.
3-2 either way. Dragonridge is the slight favorite on current form (5-0 last match). DTC #1 needs Corelle to compete at S1 and the D1 pair to hold serve.
vs DRAGONRIDGE CC (3-1). Melanie Isbell at S1 is the key threat. 35B title implications. Must-win.
vs SPANISH TRAIL #1 (1-4). Fading fast — lost 0-5 to Dragonridge in W5. DTC #1 should win 4-1.
vs RED ROCK CC #2 (4-0+). Toughest match remaining. Mary Lind (3.64) leads a deep roster. Probable loss without the full lineup. Arika Carrier (TPC) won't help here.
vs TPC (3-2). TPC is beatable — their D1 (Carrier) is strong but the rest of the lineup is inconsistent. DTC #1 should win 3-2.
Win W6 (Dragonridge) to control 35B. Even a loss there doesn't eliminate DTC #1 — they have the easier remaining schedule. Win W7 and W9, steal one from Red Rock #2, and DTC #1 finishes in the top 2.
